truthSource.label: California Secretary of State: Vote Counting Process
truthSource.oneLine: Election-night calls and concessions rest on semi-official results, not final ones. Counties have 30 days to finish the official canvass, and the Secretary of State certifies results 38 days after the election.

lesson.tip: Media calls are projections from partial, semi-official numbers. California counties keep counting for weeks, and totals are expected to move. Results are final only after counties certify and the Secretary of State compiles them.
